generalizedDefectIdentifiedFromThisAdjud.statement: ActionTag (types.ts) is a fixed, ~29-member vocabulary oriented entirely around negative/affirmative COVENANT actions (INCUR_DEBT, CREATE_LIEN, MAKE_INVESTMENT, DISPOSE_ASSET, RESTRICTED_PAYMENT, etc.). Guaranty-mechanics provisions (a guaranty of payment, a waiver of suretyship defenses, a reinstatement-upon-rescission clause, a subordination-designation obligation) have NO corresponding ActionTag value. For this entire PROVISION-TYPE CLASS - not any specific document, section, or defined term - both the ground-truth claim's and the candidate's action-dimension extraction come back empty on EITHER side of a comparison, so A_SUBJECT_ACTION resolves to NOT_APPLICABLE for the true claim AND for the false candidate alike. B_LEGAL_POSTURE, being a coarse few-way bucket (e.g. both broadly classed as an 'OBLIGATION'), then correspondswithout establishing genuine subject-matter alignment - many semantically unrelated obligations share the same coarse posture class. This leaves C_OBJECT_RESOURCE's lexical-overlap test, again, as the dimension that actually decides correspondence - and, as in 02-safe-surfacing-correspondence-spec.json and 03-definition-overmatch-root-cause.json, that test is too permissive when it is the only source of genuine discriminating evidence.
generalizedDefectIdentifiedFromThisAdjud.isThisTheSameRootCauseAsSections7And9: YES, with a refinement: the Section 7/9 forensics showed the defect when BOTH A and B are NOT_APPLICABLE. This adjudication shows the SAME underlying weakness also manifests when only A is NOT_APPLICABLE and B merely achieves a coarse, non-specific CORRESPONDS (both broadly 'obligations', 'restrictions', etc.) - because a shared coarse posture class does not, on its own, establish that two provisions concern the same subject matter. The generalized fix (05-generalized-remediation-record.json) is therefore keyed on A_SUBJECT_ACTION alone being NOT_APPLICABLE, not on both A and B together, since B's coarse correspondence does not supply the missing discriminating power.
generalizedDefectIdentifiedFromThisAdjud.syntheticAdversarialExamplesProvided: See 06-new-adversarial-tests.json - 16 new tests, including a dedicated subset targeting exactly this pattern (a genuine claim and an unrelated candidate that share only a coarse posture class and weak lexical overlap, with no fitting ActionTag on either side).

section12ChangeRuleCompliance.criterion4_notMerelyForcingReviewerAgree: The fix changes a threshold calibration in a generic dimension-assessment function based on a directly-observed, principled mechanism (a dimension's fallback state should not silently satisfy the correspondence bar when it is the sole remaining discriminator) - it does not special-case these three GT units, these two candidate IDs, or 'Article X' in any way. The rerun (10-second-pass-rerun-results.json) either does or does not change these specific cases' dispositions as a SIDE EFFECT of a change made for independent, generalized reasons - the fix was not reverse-engineered to force a particular outcome on them.
